description: Minimum details an order request email must contain to be accepted as a valid load order.

required_fields.label: Customer reference number
required_fields.description: The shipper's own identifier for the shipment, such as a PO, order, load, or sales order number.

required_fields.label: Pickup location
required_fields.description: Facility street address with city and state (ZIP preferred). A city on its own is not enough.

required_fields.label: Pickup date
required_fields.description: A specific calendar date, such as 11/2 or November 2. Vague timing like 'early next week' or 'ASAP' is not enough.

required_fields.label: Delivery location
required_fields.description: Facility street address with city and state (ZIP preferred). A city on its own is not enough.

required_fields.label: Delivery date
required_fields.description: A specific calendar date, on or after the pickup date.

required_fields.label: Weight
required_fields.description: Total shipment weight in pounds. A pallet count alone is not enough.

required_fields.label: Equipment type
required_fields.description: Trailer type needed for the load.

conditional_fields.label: Reefer temperature
conditional_fields.description: Set point in °F, plus run mode (continuous or cycle) if given.

optional_fields.label: Special instructions (load bars, tarps, washout, etc.)
